Round 314 passes: every C row ran, all three real-browser rows ran in Chromium, and I found no new bugs. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both `true`.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| SOURCE-SCOPE | 12 git status entries, as expected. App code 6/6, tree manifest exactly 3/8, protected files 11/11. Git status was the same at the start and end of my phase, so I changed no source. The 3 perf files are byte-equal to B's sketch. |
| CLAIMS | Only the expected by-design lines differ: K2, K4, K9, K10, K19. |
| CARRY | Valid, because app code is 6/6 and `budgets.json` is unchanged. |
| HARNESS-PASS | 2 perf runs, each alone after a browser warm-up. 0 failures in both. 6× clip-gain was 91 commits / 1 release commit in every pass. `harness.loaf-scripts-live` was 80 in every pass, with 1 LoAF entry. |
| ROW-EQUALITY | My own comparer: all 164 deterministic rows equal the HEAD-harness control in both runs. |
| MU-FOLLOW-SCROLL | Fails as it should: 117 failures, exactly B's K13 count (81 scroll, 12 "Follow is on", 24 "Follow is paused"). No other failure type, and the idle-bracket check never fired. |
| UNIT | 34/34 pass. B's mutant script output matches his. My own 3 mutants on `timelineScrollProblem` all go red. |
| FOLLOW-UI | Tested at 1440×900 and 1280×720 with real clicks. With Follow on, the page turns while playing. With it off, the timeline does not scroll for 5 s while playing. Off also survives Stop and Play, which doc 163 says. Turning it back on makes the view follow the playhead again. |
| G314-AUTH | Both viewports. `/studio-lab` opens the demo with no sign-in and no errors. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio. `/api/studio-token` with no header returns 401 and no token. Premium access is not bypassed. |
| DOC | Doc 163's edits are all inside the allowed sections and match the spec. Doc 228's line 4 is exact and its 7 headings are in order. Both docs keep the confirmed cause separate from the inferred one. |

Two attempts were thrown out and redone, with logs kept:
- **Auth, first run:** it timed out because the route was still compiling on the cold dev server. It passed after a browser warm-up.
- **Follow test, first run:** my script clicked Play to stop playback, but Play does not stop it while playing. That was my mistake, not an app bug. I re-ran it using Space, as the harness does.

**Notes for B:**
- **Old wording in the docs (info only):** docs 163 and 228 still say C's check is pending, while the required line 4 of doc 228 now says C round 314 PASS. B can update that sentence at the next doc edit.
- **Why C-R313-01 is closed:** the two clean 91/1 runs alone don't prove the timing-dependent problem is gone. What closes it is the new checks: any timeline scroll inside a measured window now fails the run, and the mutant shows they fire.
- **Still untested:** the idle-bracket check has no browser test that makes it fail. B's task already records this as a gap.

Gate rows (full vitest, build, Biome, `npm run verify`, e2e smoke) are left to the root gate.
